description: Show NoData's terms of use (current version) and, on the user's explicit approval, accept them. Data tools stay off until the current version is accepted. ASKS FIRST: without confirm:true it only shows the terms summary and link — show it to the user and call again with confirm:true only if they say they accept. Records operational identity only (organisation, agent, version, time, hash), never content. LANGUAGE: if the user has not chosen one, ask them — עברית or English — and pass it as `language`; it is kept for every later session and every agent on this machine.

confirm.description: true = the user accepts these terms. Omit to show them.

language.description: The language the user chose for NoData and their agents: he (עברית) or en (English).

name: nodata_terms
title: Show or accept NoData's terms
